rules.scope: C1/C2 static conservative placement and same-floor portal connectivity

warnings: C1/C2 static authoring reserve only. Radius 0.25m has no verified C3 character fit.
0.20m four-neighbour grid and square obstacle expansion are conservative. Narrow or diagonal feasible paths may be rejected.
Every grid edge, endpoint connector and portal crossing segment is checked continuously against expanded footprints.
Region boundaries are closed except for declared portals. Same-floor portal and grid connectivity is static conservative admission only.
Contact meshes, actual door hardware, stairs/lifts, vertical travel and real character navigation remain unverified.

limitations: Enclosed volumes of non-blocking meshes are sampled at their triangle surfaces only.
Motion sweeps, character fit, texture opacity and GPU rendering require separate verification.
trainingClearance.scope: Static room-local clearance against structure, blocking footprints, and actual mesh surfaces at the installed facility states.

scope: Complete deterministic authoring result. Static geometry and placement admission only; rendering and character usage require their own evidence.
